text:
alex: Heads up — I'm starting a small refactor to the API bridge that routes v5 clients to v6 handlers. Want to align on guardrails before I land it.

maya: nice. what's the primary runtime risk? :eyes:

alex: main risk is subtle behavioral drift for streaming clients — v6 returns slightly different chunk boundaries and we currently rely on chunk-index heuristics downstream.

sam: can we keep a strict compatibility mode flag on the bridge that replays old framing? i.e. keep both codepaths for a migration window.

alex: that's the idea. planning a config like:```compat_bridge: { enabled: true, mode: "v5-framing", kill_switch: false }```

zara: +1 for a kill-switch and telemetry. we need a telemetry tag that marks requests proxied vs directly handled so we can slice latency/regressions.

oncall-bot: deploy-check: staging infra ok, no failing checks on canary. :white_check_mark:

maya: also add a max-age ttl for the guardrail flag so we don't accumulate technical debt. maybe 90 days default and an admin flow to extend.

alex: sounds reasonable. I can wire the admin flow into console rollouts. question: do we want response-signature tests in CI to catch framing drift?

sam: yes — add a small golden prompt set that asserts chunk boundaries and final tokens. run on every bridge change and on model upgrades. keep it lightweight (<60s).

zara: Also, ensure the bridge emits an event when it falls back to v5-mode: `bridge.compat_mode.fallback` with fields {tenant, route, reason}. That will help rollback decisions.

alex: will do. I'll open a tiny RFC + implement the flag + telemetry. Plan: feature-flag rollout -> canary -> gradual enable all tenants -> TTL expiration. Posting a draft PR in ~1h.

maya: amazing — if you want me to review the telemetry schema ping me. :thumbsup:

sam: add a Chaos test that toggles the kill-switch during a traffic spike to validate stability.

alex: good call. adding that to the checklist. thanks folks.

oncall-bot: reminder: create postmortem template when toggling kill-switch for prod incidents (automation link: https://internal/tools/incident-template)

zara: one last thing — include a deprecation header so SDKs can surface a warning: `X-Redwood-Compat: v5-bridge`

alex: will include the header. final checklist: flag + TTL + kill-switch + telemetry tag + event + CI golden tests + chaos test + SDK header. I'll drop the PR link when ready. :rocket:
